entries.proposition: Design: 35 treatment-naive infants with infantile spasms and 35 healthy infants, bloods before and after two weeks of ACTH 1 unit per kg twice daily.
entries.snippet: The dosage was set at 1 unit per kilogram, administered twice daily continuously for 2 weeks (9).
